claims.claim: Migration/source-bootstrap staging and recovery use bounded real-Git control and target storage. Focused Windows depth regressions exercise checkout, readback, replay and interruption while preserving the existing bundle/source locator.
Full handoff identity and existing lifecycle validation remain authoritative. Separate target Git storage has an exact owner binding to the full runtime path, fingerprint, bundle and intent.

Both historical bundle formats and the three supplied immutable readers remain consumable. Partial, malformed, mismatched, colliding, stale, linked or ambiguous target storage fails closed, with cleanup preserving unrelated durable data.
The committed repair changes only operator.py and test_operator.py, preserves the excluded surfaces and authorities, and introduces no retry, fallback, skip or alternate lifecycle.
